span.p:
PR build — same Jenkinsfile, gated
runs validate · lint · test · build · scan
Push and Trigger CD are SKIPPED
an unapproved PR can never reach the registry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1-2 Checkout and validate
git short SHA becomes the image tag
hadolint x4 · shellcheck · helm lint · helm template

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3-4 Lint and test
flake8 · pytest
results published to Jenkins as JUnit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5-6 Build and scan
BuildKit rootless x3 → local OCI tarball
Trivy: CycloneDX SBOM + CRITICAL gate
nothing has been pushed yet

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7-9 Push and record
ECR login via IRSA (RAM-only token)
push x3, tag = git SHA, digest captured
image-manifest.json archived

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ECR
vm-order-*:<git-sha>
IMMUTABLE tags

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
hand-off — build job: application-cd
IMAGE_TAG · 3 digests · CI build number · commit SHA

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1-3 Validate the request
reject empty · reject 'latest' · must match a git SHA
verify the tag exists in ECR (read-only)
helm lint + server-side dry run

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 APPROVAL
a human clicks Deploy
Jenkins records who, what version, which namespace

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5-6 Deploy and roll out
helm upgrade --install x3 --wait
kubectl rollout status x3

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7-9 Verify
running image == requested tag
smoke test: /healthz · /api/health · public ALB
deployment record → S3

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CI FAILED
nothing pushed to the registry
application-cd never triggered
email notification sent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ROLLBACK
collect events and pod logs first
then helm rollback x3
build FAILED · email sent
